It is non-security and not a release blocker, but it touches test controls for path, parser, provenance, workflow, and CI contracts, so behavior-preserving review and focused controls are required. It cannot resolve FND-SONAR-0002.

root_cause: Affected unittest assertions use expected, actual positional order. Sonar S3415 requires actual, expected for intended failure diagnostics. The active 507-key current-master set is the same cause as the historical 15-key PR #42 subset, but a distinct current observation and independently actionable residual scope. Argument evaluation order must be retained.
root_cause_de: Betroffene unittest-Assertions verwenden die positionale Reihenfolge erwartet, tatsächlich. Sonar S3415 verlangt tatsächlich, erwartet für die beabsichtigte Fehlerdiagnostik. Die aktive aktuelle 507-Key-Master-Menge ist dieselbe Ursache wie die historische 15-Key-PR-#42-Teilmenge, aber eine getrennte aktuelle Beobachtung und unabhängig bearbeitbarer Rest-Scope. Die Argumentauswertungsreihenfolge muss erhalten bleiben.
proposed_remediation: Completed: review and correct the first two assertion arguments at all 507 current Framework-owned locations, preserving side-effect order with reviewed local temporaries where required. Focused controls, native lint/documentation checks, and fresh exact-head Sonar validation passed without weakening or bypassing a scanner or test control.
proposed_remediation_de: Abgeschlossen: Die ersten zwei Assertion-Argumente an allen 507 aktuellen Framework-eigenen Stellen wurden geprüft und korrigiert; erforderliche Seiteneffekt-Reihenfolge bleibt mit geprüften lokalen Temporaries erhalten. Fokussierte Controls, native Lint-/Dokumentations-Checks und frische Sonar-Validierung des exakten Heads bestanden ohne Abschwächung oder Umgehung eines Scanner- oder Test-Controls.
acceptance_criteria: All 507 current S3415 locations use actual, expected ordering with no relation, message, fixture, control, or evaluation-order change.
Side-effecting expressions receive reviewed safe treatment rather than a blind swap.
Focused affected test-family and legitimate-control suites pass.

Review the task-owned diff for two-argument order only and scan it for prohibited suppressions or expectation changes.
Run changed modules by family, legitimate controls, native make lint, documentation/change-record checks, and git diff --check.
After normal Draft PR creation, verify local/remote/PR head equality and fresh exact-head Sonar result.
legitimate_control_tests: Existing accepted and rejected path-containment, parser/provenance, workflow/action-pin, protocol, and Makefile fixtures retain their prior asserted outcome and diagnostic.
dependencies: No FND-FRAMEWORK-0050 delivery dependency remains: PR #43 is merged and its original S3415 scope is verified on resulting Framework master. The independent FND-SONAR-0002 master Quality Gate blocker remains outside this finding.

The selected local CPython 3.14.4 interpreter is compatibility evidence and does not replace the configured CPython 3.14.6 hosted job or SonarQube Cloud validation.
The current-master inventory proves the pre-remediation 507-key state only; it cannot prove a later PR head.

PR #43 is merged and its resulting master is verified for the original S3415 scope; the independent resulting-master Security-C gate is not evidence that this maintainability remediation regressed.
residual_risk: A bulk positional swap can inadvertently change argument evaluation order or test diagnostics. Only reviewed assertion calls may change, every affected control family must be rerun, and no scanner/test control may be weakened. No risk is accepted.
